instructions:
1. Set the cable to a low position and grip the handle in one hand.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat and knees slightly bent.
3. Pin your upper arm against your side with the elbow bent at 90 degrees.
4. Straighten the elbow to extend your arm fully behind you, keeping the upper arm still.
5. Lower under control back to the bent position, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move only at the elbow; keep the upper arm locked in place.
2. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
3. Keep your core braced to stop the torso swinging.
4. Use a light weight to keep the motion strict.

instructions:
1. Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your upper arms are parallel to the floor at the handles.
2. Grip the handles with elbows bent and tucked close to your sides.
3. Keep your torso upright to keep tension on the triceps.
4. Press the handles down by straightening your elbows fully.
5. Return slowly to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep elbows tucked to your sides throughout.
2. Stay upright; leaning forward shifts work to the chest.
3. Press through full extension and squeeze the triceps.
4. Control the negative; do not let the weight drop.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Raise your right arm to shoulder height and bring it across your chest.
3. Use your left hand to hold the right arm just below the elbow.
4. Draw the arm across your chest until you feel a gentle stretch in the triceps and rear shoulder.
5. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso facing forward; do not twist.
2. Breathe slowly and relax into the stretch.
3. Pull gently; the stretch should not hurt.
4. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Interlace your fingers and extend your arms straight ahead at shoulder height, palms facing away.
3. Round your upper back and push your hands forward, separating your shoulder blades.
4. Drop your chin toward your chest to deepen the stretch.
5. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, feeling the stretch between the shoulder blades.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Breathe slowly and relax into the stretch.
2. Keep your shoulders down, not shrugged toward your ears.
3. Push the hands away to spread the shoulder blades.
4. Keep the stretch gentle and pain-free.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip about shoulder-width.
2. Let the bar hang against your thighs with arms straight.
3. Pull the bar up the front of your body by lifting your elbows.
4. Raise until the bar reaches chest height, keeping elbows above the wrists.
5. Lower the bar slowly back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead the movement with your elbows.
2. Keep the bar close to your body throughout.
3. Exhale lifting, inhale lowering.
4. Do not swing or use momentum.
